welcome.subtitle: Overlay for AION 2
welcome.title:
Waiting for you
to enter AION 2
welcome.trayHint: Open the editor anytime from the Aurion icon next to the clock.

steps.profile: Create or import a profile in the editor. Save it with Ctrl+S.
steps.game: Launch AION 2 and enter the world. Npcap is required to receive game data.
steps.journal: Enable the DPS / HPS meter in Aurion settings. Fights are saved in the journal.

welcome.noticeDescription: The overlay will appear when you enter AION 2.

updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: Checks GitHub at startup and every 4 hours. Install new versions manually.
updates.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again later or open the releases page.
updates.openFailed: Could not open the browser. Releases: github.com/Oceangrace/Aurion/releases

interfaces.title: Interface editor
interfaces.subtitle: AION 2 · Interfaces
interfaces.multiSelectHint: Shift + click: add to or remove from selection. Drag any selected element to move the selection together.
interfaces.multiSelected: Selected: {count}. Properties apply to the last selected element.
interfaces.name: Name

information.descriptionHint: What this interface does and how to use it
information.author: Author
information.importedMetadata: Author and version are preserved from the imported interface.
information.displayHint: A HUD is laid out for one resolution and scales as a whole on other screens. Panel scale in the settings does not affect the HUD.
information.baseMissing: Not set: coordinates are current screen pixels
information.baseHint: The screen this HUD was built on. Set it before sharing the profile.
information.scaleHint: Manual adjustment on top of auto scale. Each block grows from its centre.

export.title: Export interface
export.hint: Share a profile folder or an interface string.
export.author: Author: {author}
export.importHint: Paste the string in the Import section.
export.folderHint: A folder named after the interface will be created in the selected location, with interface.json and separate dictionaries in locales. Share the entire folder.

interfaces.previewBadge: Preview · game events are not connected
interfaces.arrangeHint: Placement mode · drag elements · Escape to exit
interfaces.contextHint: The enemy narrows the effect list. The recipient is your character; this does not filter the caster.
interfaces.moreResults: Found {total}. Showing the first {shown} — refine your search.
interfaces.durationHint: This controls your notification duration, not the skill duration or cooldown.
interfaces.whileEffect: While the effect is confirmed active
interfaces.effectTimeHint: A timer requires a known effect end time.
interfaces.triggerIncomplete: Choose an entry and variant to apply the trigger.
interfaces.triggerSaved: The selected rule is saved with the interface.
interfaces.unsupported: The selected entry is unavailable. Choose a supported variant again.
interfaces.allFormsHint: “Any form” includes only confirmed variants. Select it explicitly.

create.title: Create
create.hint: Choose an element type for your interface

anchors.title: Group anchors
anchors.relativeWidth: Width as a percentage of group
anchors.relativeHeight: Height as a percentage of group

visual.groupScaleHint: Scales the entire group: icons, text, spacing and nested groups. Width and height define the layout area before scaling.
visual.imageError: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 150 KB

import.hint: Paste an interface string, choose a file or a profile folder.
import.installed: This interface is already in your library. Choose how to import it.
import.title: Import
import.clipboard: Paste into the field with ⌘V / Ctrl+V.

rules.title: Tracking rules

options.hit-landed: Hit landed without a reported amount

rules.castDurationFromEvent: The countdown uses the duration reported for this ability preparation.
rules.gameIdsHint: Optional: exact effect IDs (up to 32) or one ability ID, including entries missing from the catalog. Empty means any.
rules.invalidGameIds: Use positive whole IDs up to 4294967295; one ability or up to 32 effects.

formulas.title: Formulas
formulas.constantHint: A constant value, identical for every calculation.
formulas.empty: Create a formula to use calculations in your interface elements.

data.title: Game data
data.formats: Format after a colon: 0 — integer, 0.0 — tenths, k — 12.4K.
data.noLoadFields: The source does not yet provide combat, party, class or zone data for load rules.

fieldNames.name: Name
fieldNames.hp_restored: HP restored from the previous observation
fieldNames.mp_restored: MP restored from the previous observation
fieldNames.nextWorldBoss_id: Nearest announced boss respawn: map ID

redesign.deleteMessage: All elements and formulas in this interface will also be removed.

hints.content: The name and text displayed by this element.
hints.position: Element coordinates and dimensions. Hold Ctrl while dragging to keep the selection and move a selected group through its children. Arrow keys: 1 px; Shift + arrows: 10 px.
hints.hierarchy: Parent element and order within the group.
hints.what: Choose an event and a skill or effect.
hints.when: When and how long to show the element.
hints.sound: A signal or speech when triggered.
hints.changes: What to change when the conditions are met.

runtime.firstLaunchHint: If Aurion was started inside the world, use a class ability. If the name, HP/MP or skills are still missing, keep Aurion running and re-enter your character.

skillStateHints.cooldown: Shows a countdown after observed use. Base duration is an estimate; server corrections replace it when available.
skillStateHints.skill_ready: Readiness is known only after observing use and a server cooldown remainder. An expired base estimate does not prove readiness.
skillStateHints.combo_available: Shows the skill while the server reports that its combo step is available.
skillStateHints.skill_state: One icon stays visible. Its timer follows the cooldown; the selected active-effect rule temporarily takes priority. Conditions control its appearance.

loadIds.hint: Optional exact IDs, separated by commas. Maps and dungeons are alternative locations; the NPC filter is an additional requirement.
loadIds.invalid: Use up to 512 positive whole IDs (1–4294967295).

healing.title: Periodic healing prediction
healing.estimateHint: ≈ Remaining observed periodic healing. Excess is estimated against current HP, without future damage or other heals.

interfaces.effectIconUnknown: No known icon for this effect
interfaces.catalogAllForms: All variants of the selected ability are tracked automatically.
interfaces.legacyEffectFilter: The imported filter is preserved. Choose an effect to replace it.

hudTranslations.title: Languages in this HUD
hudTranslations.hint: Translations are stored inside the interface and included in its export. The HUD follows the application language. Edit source text in element properties.
hudTranslations.fallback: Empty uses source text. Keep placeholders. Identical texts share one translation.
hudTranslations.unused: This text is no longer used; its translation is preserved.
hudTranslations.fieldsWarning: Preserve every placeholder in braces, including number formats.
hudTranslations.more: Showing the first 100 texts — refine your search.

interfaces.effectCatalogHint: The catalog provides effect names. The unit selected above determines whose effects are observed.

samples.title: Preview
samples.notice: Local simulation · not recorded in combat history

bosses.hint: Open the boss list on the in-game map to receive timers.
bosses.empty: The panel stays hidden in game while the list is empty.

combatJournal.title: Combat journal
combatJournal.name: Window name
combatJournal.empty: Waiting for combat. Completed combats are saved locally between sessions.
combatJournal.partial: Incomplete data: shown values are observed amounts, not a verified full DPS or game ranking.
combatJournal.historyHint: Select a fight or run in the meter header. Statistics controls are below; preview never changes real history.
combatJournal.customColors: Custom colors instead of application theme

analysis.title: Combat analysis
analysis.directDenominator: Modifier rates use direct hits, excluding periodic ticks. A dash means insufficient data.
analysis.tracePartial: Event trace is partial: late attachment, missing data or retention limit. Charts and CPM may be lower bounds; totals above come from separate counters.
analysis.noEvents: No confirmed events for this selection.
analysis.singleCombat: Timeline, effects and event logs require a single combat. Select a combat from history.
analysis.noEffects: No observed effect intervals. This does not establish that no effects were active.
analysis.noDeaths: No observed deaths for this participant.
analysis.zoomHint: Drag to zoom into an interval
analysis.castsUnavailable: Casts are available for a complete fight without a target filter.
analysis.intervalHint: Totals use recorded events inside the selection. Incomplete recordings may omit events.

combatJournal.headerOrderHint: Drag a button into place, or select it and use the ← → arrows.
combatJournal.headerOrderEmpty: Enable the buttons you need below.
combatJournal.headerOrderSelect: Select a button in the strip above
